address: 945 Soi Wanit 2, Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok, 10100, Thailand
bio: Popular with locals in Talat Noi, this family-run eatery in its second generation specialises in braised duck and goose. The silky meat and aromatic broth pair perfectly with flat egg noodles topped with mixed offal – a must-try. Come before lunch, as the goose sells out fast.
